fit.title: Residual income
fit.reason: For a bank, deposits and financing are part of operations. Start with common book value, sustainable ROE, cost of equity and regulatory capital; generic enterprise FCFF/WACC can be misleading.
fit.caution: Common book value must exclude preferred/AT1 capital and noncontrolling interests. Review clean-surplus adjustments and distributable capital.
fit.statement: No model is always most accurate. This is an explainable starting point, not a verified survey of current Wall Street analyst usage.
